d:
Israil men 27 aktubar ko sansdiy chunav ho rahe hain. desh men sabse lanbe samay tak pradhanmantri rahe binyamin netanyahu ki nazar ab satven karyakal par hai.
77 sal ke netanyahu dashkon se khud ko israil ke 'mistar sikyoriti' ke rup men pesh karte rahe hain. lekin is bar vah ek aise samay men dobara pradhanmantri banne ki koshish kar rahe hain, jab bahut se israili sat aktubar 2023 ke hamas ke netritv vale hamlon ko desh ke itihas ki sabse bari suraksha viphalta mante hain.
